newsitem.title: USA: Armstrong sees Q3 hurt by $0.53 a share.
newsitem.headline: Armstrong sees Q3 hurt by $0.53 a share.

text.p: Armstrong World Industries said on Thursday that its third-quarter after-tax earnings will suffer by about $22 million, or $0.53 per share, because of a discoloration in one of its sheet flooring lines.

Costs of the problem include about a $13 million after-tax writedown, the company said. The company said it also will create a $9 million after-tax contingency reserve to cover the potential cost of removing and replacing the discolored product.
The company said the discoloration potentially affects less than four percent of its flooring unit volume produced in the U.S., or about 4.5 million square yards.
First Call consensus estimates put Armstrong's third quarter earnings at $1.47 per share. First Call listed year-ago figures at $1.26 per share.
Armstrong said it will release third quarter results on October 14.
